create.name: Mark Coleman
create.bio:
Mark Coleman first sat down to meditate as a teenage punk in London, and the practice took him on to India and the United States for long silent retreats. He trained in Insight meditation with Christopher Titmuss, Joseph Goldstein, Sharon Salzberg and Jack Kornfield, who later authorised him to teach, and also studied Dzogchen with Nyoshul Khenpo Rinpoche and Tsoknyi Rinpoche. Since the late 1990s he has led retreats at Spirit Rock Meditation Center in California, where he is one of the senior teachers.

His special interest is meditating outdoors. Through Awake in the Wild he guides silent wilderness retreats and a year-long training for people who want to lead nature meditation, and with Martin Aylward he runs the Mindfulness Training Institute, which prepares mindfulness teachers in the US and Europe. He also brings secular mindfulness into companies and public bodies. He has written Awake in the Wild and A Field Guide to Nature Meditation, as well as Make Peace with Your Mind, on loosening the grip of the inner critic, and From Suffering to Peace, and his guided practices appear on Waking Up, Insight Timer and Dharma Seed. He lives in Marin County, California, and teaches in person and online.

books.title: Awake in the Wild: Mindfulness in Nature as a Path of Self-Discovery
books.author: Mark Coleman
books.description: His first book on taking meditation outside, with a foreword by Jack Kornfield. It pairs reflections from his wilderness retreats with simple exercises for paying attention to land, weather, plants and animals.

books.title: Make Peace with Your Mind: How Mindfulness and Compassion Can Free You from Your Inner Critic
books.author: Mark Coleman
books.description: A practical look at the voice of self-judgement and where it comes from, with a foreword by Tara Brach. Each chapter offers mindfulness and kindness practices for meeting that voice without being ruled by it.

books.title: From Suffering to Peace: The True Promise of Mindfulness
books.author: Mark Coleman
books.description: A broad guide to mindfulness that goes back to its Buddhist roots rather than treating it as a technique alone. It moves from attention to the body and mind through to ethics, compassion and inner freedom.

courses.title: The Rewilding Summit
courses.description: A four-day gathering at Kripalu, hosted by Micah Mortali, on living closer to the land in a fast-changing world, joinable on site or online. Mark leads one of the day-long deep dives, on listening to and receiving from the Earth.

courses.title: Make Peace with Your Judging Mind: How Mindfulness and Compassion Can Help Free You from the Inner Critic
courses.description: A weekend workshop at Esalen in Big Sur drawn from his book on self-judgement. Guided meditation, kindness practice and reflection help participants notice the critical inner voice and relate to it more gently.
courses.price: From $940 USD including lodging and meals

courses.title: Awake in the Wild: Mindfulness in Nature to Open the Senses and Awaken the Heart
courses.description: An outdoor meditation weekend on the Big Sur coast, co-led with Lori Schwanbeck. Sensory awareness and heart practices are done in the open air, treating the landscape itself as a teacher.
courses.price: From $940 USD including lodging and meals

courses.title: Wisdom of Gratitude & Teachings of Nature in Baja
courses.description: A five-day Thanksgiving retreat in Baja, Mexico, led with Lori Schwanbeck and Teddi Dean. Days of nature-based mindfulness and slowing down end with a shared Thanksgiving meal.

courses.title: Mindfulness Teacher Training – Based in North America
courses.description: A ten-month professional training with Martin Aylward for people who teach, or want to teach, mindfulness. It mixes in-person intensives, online study, mentoring and peer groups alongside deepening one's own practice.

courses.title: Resilience and Nature
courses.description: A self-paced online course on his own site, with recorded teachings and outdoor meditations to practise wherever you live. Access lasts ninety days.

courses.title: Mindfulness in Nature: Cultivating Embodied Awareness
courses.description: An on-demand course hosted by Sangha Live that draws on Buddhist teachings about attention and gratitude. Modules take the practice outdoors, working with the elements and the senses.

free_resources.title: Dharma talks and guided meditations on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: A large free archive of his recorded talks and guided sittings from retreats at Spirit Rock and elsewhere. Good for following the Insight tradition at home.

free_resources.title: Guided meditations on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His free guided practices on the Insight Timer app, linked from his website. Many of them bring the outdoors into meditation.
